# `atanh`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
atanh(expr)
```

Returns inverse hyperbolic tangent of `expr`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples
